{
 "query": "Luxury Gourmet Food Website Design",
 "filters": {
  "industry": "food-beverage"
 },
 "count": 4,
 "tip": "Thumbnails inline. Top rows carry the fold autopsy; get_screen(slug) for the others. Hero complete inside 1280x800; 80-160px between sections; copy in a centered padded column.",
 "images": "https://0nme3pk5am3urwa9.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/captures/<slug>/hero.1440.webp (also full.1440, thumb.384, mobile.384; get_screen returns exact URLs)",
 "results": [
  {
   "slug": "atomixnyc-com",
   "title": "Atomixnyc",
   "northstar": "Deep teal and rust hues flow across a spacious, elegant layout with subtly crisp, modern typography.",
   "autopsy": "FOLD: Full-bleed textile hero fills entire viewport. Top-left: circular line logo. Top-right: hamburger icon. Center: three nav links in horizontal row - \"CHEF'S COUNTER\", \"BAR TASTING\", \"ABOUT US\" - all caps, evenly spaced. No headline, no body copy, no CTA button. Hero visual: draped dark fabric with oversized coral/teal floral print, deep folds creating shadow valleys, small navy card with gold circular emblem partially visible upper center. Textile occupies 100% of viewport. Nav sits in optical center, floating on fabric.\n\nTYPE: Sans-serif, medium weight, wide tracking, all caps for nav. No body text visible. Scale: single size only.\n\nCOLOR: Background: near-black fabric (#471e13). Text: warm off-white/cream. Accent: coral (#c95535) and muted teal (#84989a) in print; gold line emblem. No buttons or links to accent.\n\nSIGNATURE: Navigation as sole content, treated as centered floating signage over luxurious textile photography - no container, no hero text hierarchy, pure material backdrop.",
   "palette": ["#c95535", "#471e13", "#e3a696", "#aa7668", "#84989a"],
   "fonts": ["ambroise-std", "Heebo"],
   "mode": "dark",
   "macro": "split-studio",
   "axes": "dark / roman-serif / warm / ambroise-std",
   "tags": "minimalism, editorial, swiss, dark-mode · food-beverage · calm, luxe, soft · sticky-nav, hero-with-cta, logo-cloud"
  },
  {
   "slug": "deathandcompany-com",
   "title": "Deathandcompany",
   "northstar": "Deep charcoal expanse, elegant script dances above cool, metallic textures.",
   "autopsy": "FOLD: Full-bleed photo hero. No nav visible except hamburger (top-right). Centered: ornate cocktail-glass illustration with crossed spoons and botanical flourishes, above script \"Death & Co\" in white. No supporting copy. No CTA in main viewport. Two small UI elements: \"GET $50 ON US\" pill (bottom-left) and accessibility icon (bottom-right). Pause button centered below logo. Photo shows hands garnishing a cocktail over perforated metal bar surface; hero visual occupies 100% viewport. Headline and illustration sit dead center, small against immersive dark photography - visual dominates, text reads as watermark.\n\nTYPE: Display: high-contrast script serif, swashy, elegant, medium weight. Body: none visible. Scale jump: N/A (single display size only). All lowercase except \"D\" and \"C\" capitals.\n\nCOLOR: Background: near-black photo (#0a0a0a). Text/illustration: warm white (#f5f0e6). Accent: muted blue (#1877b5) on accessibility icon; warm brown (#685014, #9e8769) in palette hint only, not visibly deployed.\n\nSIGNATURE: Ornate engraved illustration layered directly over photographic cocktail, creating trompe-l'oeil where drawn glass merges with real drink below - illustration bottom aligns with photo glass stem.",
   "palette": ["#1877b5", "#685014", "#89c7ef", "#9e8769", "#b9b9bd"],
   "fonts": ["Diplomata SC", "EB Garamond", "Oswald"],
   "mode": "dark",
   "macro": "marquee-hero",
   "axes": "dark / grotesk-sans / cool / Diplomata SC",
   "tags": "minimalism, editorial, dark-mode · food-beverage · serious, luxe, cold · hero-fullbleed, logo-cloud"
  },
  {
   "slug": "dinnerbyheston-com",
   "title": "Dinnerbyheston",
   "northstar": "Deep charcoal expanse, elegant sans-serif whispers on a stark, spacious field.",
   "autopsy": "FOLD: Nav top-center: \"DINNER\" in spaced caps with vertical bars between letters, \"by heston blumenthal\" beneath. Headline centered: \"din·ner\" lowercase with interpunct, \"[noun]\" italic beneath, thin horizontal rule below. Two definition lines follow, \"MIDDAY\" and \"EVENING\" in all-caps. CTA: ghost button \"VIEW OUR RESTAURANTS\" with crown icon. No hero visual - pure typographic specimen on solid ground. Headline occupies upper-middle third; generous negative space dominates ~70% of viewport.\n\nTYPE: Display: high-contrast transitional serif, light weight, sharp terminals. Body: same family, smaller, regular weight. Scale jump ~3:1. Signature: spaced all-caps nav, italic bracketed part of speech, interpunct in headline.\n\nCOLOR: Background #424241 warm dark gray. Text #bdbdbc light gray. Accent #c1c1c0 on rule, button border, highlighted \"MIDDAY\"/\"EVENING\". No true white anywhere.\n\nSIGNATURE: Dictionary entry structure - word broken with interpunct, bracketed grammatical label, horizontal rule, then definitions with selective all-caps emphasis - treating restaurant name as lexicographic specimen.",
   "palette": ["#80807e", "#424241", "#bdbdbc", "#8d8c8c", "#c1c1c0"],
   "fonts": [],
